title: LS_34159_PH_Manila.mp3 by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Ramble in Manila, Philippines. (binaural, please use headset for 3D effect). This binaural audio file is one of the recordings I made in Manila a few days before Christmas 2018, while I was rambling in the shops and in the crowded streets of Divisoria and Baklaran, which are two places where you can find many sellers and vendors who sell everything you’d like to buy... Here, I’m just sitting in a calm place with some people talking in the small shops around, and in the distance, you can hear sounds coming from a crowded street. Recorded in December 2018 with an Olympus LS-3 and Soundman OKM I
modifications: cut 8.94-23.94s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -23.00 dBFS); 30 ms fades
